text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Now that we're done shopping, once we get 
back to the academy, I've gotta give it my 
all in training today too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, the city really is nothing but 
tall buildings, huh."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Back home, all you see are mountains and 
rice fields, and the only tall things are 
steel transmission towers, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~... Just how many floors is that 
buildin'? Looks almost as tall as Tokyo 
Tower.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Isn't that one over there even 
taller!? No way, the building behind that 
is crazy big too!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...An' then, while lookin' for the 
tallest buildin', I lost track of time..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm really, REALLY sorry for skipping 
training!!

Since she seemed to regret her actions, I 
gave her a stern reminder to be more 
careful in the future.
